hero.sub1: Small, kind tools for feelings, routines and calm,
hero.sub2: for you or for a child you care for.
hero.sub3: Private, gentle, and never a diagnosis.

feel.title: Feel & reflect
feel.text: Mood check-ins, a private journal and feelings cards.
feel.alt: A boy and his dog on a hill path among sheep, above the sea

features.lead: Gentle tools to help you pause, reflect and find your balance again, whenever you need them.

feelings.title: Understand your feelings
feelings.text: Check in with how you feel, without judgement. Notice patterns over time and reflect at your own pace.

habits.title: Build small habits
habits.text: Routines in small, clear steps, gentle reminders, and a little celebration for every win.

calm.title: Find your calm
calm.text: Breathing, grounding, calm sounds and sing-along rhymes for whenever things feel like a lot.

showcase.lead: Your calm corner goes wherever you do, and picks up right where you left it.

entry.lead: Choose your way in. Each one opens a space made for you.
entry.adultText: Sign in for your own wellbeing, or to support a child you care for.
entry.childText: Use your family code and your secret PIN to open your own space.

promise.lead: SafeSpace supports wellbeing, reflection and everyday coping. It never diagnoses.

stigma.title: Support without stigma
stigma.text: Tools for routines, focus, senses and feelings that fit your rhythm, not a label.

privacy.title: Privacy with dignity
privacy.text: Young people's privacy grows with their age, and safety alerts always reach a grown-up when it matters.

caregivers.title: Caregivers, alongside
caregivers.text: Caregivers get calm tools and a clear view of what helps, without watching every move.

footer.lead: Kind, accessible support for everyday wellbeing. Never a diagnosis.
